**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

- **§ 12.3 (p0044)** is a full sourcing-freedom clause: nothing restricts us from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service or engaging any supplier, and Vendor expressly acknowledges we have made "no exclusivity … commitment." That satisfies the sole preferred element.
- Searches for "exclusive", "sole", requirements-purchase and third-party-procurement wording surfaced only provisions that do not bind our sourcing: a non-exclusive licence **to us** (§ 13.1), Vendor's Deliverable ownership (§ 14.2), exclusive-remedy clauses (§§ 19.4, 21.4) and exclusive-forum clauses (§§ 28.1–28.2).
- **§ 7.2** (disclose-and-match before engaging another provider) is a right-to-match/MFN mechanic — it does not prohibit engaging alternatives once honoured, so it is reserved for MFN and not double-flagged here.
- **§ 2.1** take-or-pay is a volume commitment for MINCOMMIT, not exclusive dealing.

No redline proposed.
